description:
[Wicked Registry] Register a tool you own so it gets real synthetic checks and a live score. Get the exact message to sign from registry_onboarding_message(action=register), sign it with owner_wallet, then call this. This tool never signs.

Use when you own a tool and want it listed and monitored, with your wallet's signature over the registration message. Not for finding tools.

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

owner_wallet.description: 0x wallet that signed the registration message.

schema_url.description: Optional JSON Schema URL enabling the schema-conformance score.

signature.description: 0x-prefixed ECDSA signature over the registration message.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp used in the signed message (within an hour of the call).

name: registry_register_tool
